page.layout: One page of text, with two medallion illustrations with legends at the top, centred above the text block. Below them, three paragraphs of running text, full width. No margin notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.l: SATURNUS BABILON
BEL. IUPITER.
NEMROD Saturnus, filius Chus, filij Cham, filij Noë,
cœpit esse potens in terra. Fuit autem principiū regni eius Ba-
bylon, Arach, Achad & Chalanne, in terra Sennaar, anno mūdi
1788. ante Christum 2174. nempe ipso eodem anno supradicto
quo genitus est Reu. Hoc regnante facta est linguarum cōfusio
in ædificatione turris Babel. Josephus lib. Anti.1.cap.9.citat hæc
verba Sibyllæ: Cum omnes homines unius vocis exifterent,
quidam turrim ædificaverūt excelsam, tanquam ascensuri per
eam in cœlum: Dij vero immittētes ventos, everterunt turrim,
& voce propria unicuique partiti sunt: propterea Babyloniam
vocari contigit civitatem, hoc est confusionem. Vide Gene.
cap.10.& 11.& Berosum lib.4.& 5.
BELUS Juppiter, quum pater suus Nemrod imperitasset
56. annos, regnauit ipse filius, anno mundi 1844. ante Christum
natū 2118. Hic designata fundamenta Babyloniæ, oppidi magis
quàm urbis similitudine, erexit. pace fruebatur usque circa fi-
nem imperij sui. Berosum cōsule li.5. ut supra. Imperauit Belus
hic annos 62.
COMERUS Gallus more Scythico, unde venerat, do-
cuit suos Italos urbem curribus componere. Vide Bero. lib.
5. Justi. lib. j. Diod. Si. lib. 3. & Anni. Viterben.

page.notes: The two medallion legends are printed around the coins: left "SATURNUS" and "BABILON", right "BEL." and "IUPITER.". The coin portraits are illustrations and are not transcribed. The page number is printed in old-style figures at the top left. Spelling and punctuation are as printed, with u/v and i/j normalised. Long s is rendered as plain s. "Anti.1.cap.9.citat" is run together as printed, without spaces around the stops. The word "exifterent" is read from the scan as printed.
